raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator redirected the task to “gather information on sample standard deviations” from ScienceDirect instead of instructing WebSurfer to extract the counts of Reference Works by domain (the necessary inputs) and then compute the sample standard deviations. This mis-specified objective led WebSurfer to search for “sample standard deviation” content (e.g., a stats methodology article) rather than the 2022 Reference Works counts by Life Sciences and Health Sciences domains, derailing the workflow and preventing calculation of the correct difference (0.269).
